amyQuiz.title: What Kind of Santiago Are You?
amyQuiz.subtitle: Take this Amy Santiago–style personality quiz to discover your organizational superpowers!
amyQuiz.amyIntro: Alright birthday detective, let's see what kind of Santiago you really are. Binders ready? Let's go!
amyQuiz.finalMessage: The whole Nine-Nine is celebrating YOU today! Even Captain Holt cracked a smile. 💙

questions.question: How do you organize your day?

characterComment.text: This is the most important question. Your planner says everything about you!

answers.subtext: Every second scheduled in color-coded binders
I have a spreadsheet for my spreadsheets
I have a general plan but can adapt
Last-minute everything, somehow it works

questions.question: Your friend asks for birthday party help. You...

characterComment.text: Oh honey, we all know you're gonna make a binder for this

answers.subtext: Complete with vendor comparisons and budget breakdowns
Guest lists, RSVP tracking, and timeline charts

answers.text: Suggest cool ideas and help coordinate
answers.subtext: Organized but keeping it fun and flexible
Spontaneity is the spice of parties!

characterComment.text: Amy's closet is literally sorted by season, color, AND occasion. It's beautiful and terrifying.

answers.subtext: All hangers facing the same direction, obviously
I track what I wear and optimize accordingly
Grouped by type, easy to find things
I know where everything is... mostly

questions.question: Someone changes plans last minute. You...

characterComment.text: Adaptability is crucial for a detective. Let's see how you handle unexpected variables.

answers.text: Panic briefly, then make new binder
answers.subtext: Must reorganize everything immediately!
Recalculate timeline and adjust spreadsheets
I can adapt while staying organized
Change is my middle name

characterComment.text: Please say binders and highlighters. Please say binders and highlighters.

answers.subtext: 12 different highlighter colors minimum
Everything synced and tracked
Focused but not obsessive
I work best when I'm in the flow

questions.question: You're planning a trip. First thing you do?

characterComment.text: Amy made an itinerary for our honeymoon with bathroom break timestamps. It was... thorough.

answers.subtext: Including backup plans for every scenario
Flights, hotels, activities all scored and ranked

answers.text: Research and make a flexible plan
answers.subtext: Key things booked, rest we'll figure out

answers.text: Book flight and go with the flow
answers.subtext: Adventure is about spontaneity!

characterComment.text: Amy throws herself a surprise party. She organizes it herself.

answers.subtext: Add to my organized list of accomplishments
Create a success metrics dashboard
Share the win and plan something fun
No big deal, on to the next thing

questions.question: Final question: What's your life motto?

answers.text: If it's not in the binder, it didn't happen
answers.subtext: Documentation is everything
Numbers don't lie
Best of both worlds

answers.text: Life's too short for too many plans
answers.subtext: Go with the vibe

personalities.title: The Ultra-Organized Santiago
personalities.description: You're Amy Santiago at her finest! You have a binder for everything, your planner is color-coded, and you've already planned next month's birthday. Your organizational skills are legendary, and you bring structure to every situation. Captain Holt would be proud!
personalities.birthdayMessage: Case closed, Detective! You've got Amy-level organization. And today, every calendar is cleared to celebrate YOU. 🎂

reactions.text: OH MY GOD you're basically me! This is the best birthday present ever!
I knew it! You're definitely bringing a binder to your own party.
Outstanding organizational capacity. Your efficiency rating is exceptional.
You're like Amy but it's your birthday so we'll allow the extra planning.

personalities.title: The Spreadsheet Queen
personalities.description: You don't just organize—you optimize! You've got spreadsheets for everything, you track data like a pro, and your decision-making is 100% metrics-driven. You're Amy Santiago with a double major in statistics. Efficiency is your superpower!
personalities.birthdayMessage: Officially an Amy Reformation Captain! Your data analysis skills are off the charts. Happy Birthday to the queen of spreadsheets! 📈

reactions.text: You have spreadsheets for your spreadsheets? We need to be best friends!
I'm scared and impressed at the same time.
Your analytical approach is commendable. Carry on.
All these numbers are making my brain hurt but you do you, Excel Queen.

personalities.title: The Balanced Santiago
personalities.description: You've mastered the art of organized flexibility! You plan ahead but can adapt when needed. You're Amy Santiago post-character development—still organized but way more chill about it. You bring structure without stress, and that's a superpower!
personalities.birthdayMessage: Perfect balance detected! You're organized when it matters and flexible when life happens. That's true Santiago wisdom. Happy Birthday! 🎯

reactions.text: You're like future me after Jake taught me to relax a little. Love it!
See Amy? This is the perfect amount of planning!
Adaptability paired with structure. Well done.
Finally someone who gets that life needs SOME planning. Respect.

personalities.title: The Laid-Back Santiago
personalities.description: You're Santiago in spirit but Peralta in practice! You've got the heart of Amy but the spontaneity of Jake. You wing it, you adapt, and somehow everything works out. You're proof that not everything needs a binder—but Amy might try to convince you otherwise!
personalities.birthdayMessage: You're like Jake trying to be Amy, and honestly? It's working! Your spontaneous energy is perfect for celebrating. Happy Birthday! 🎉

reactions.text: Okay but... have you considered making just ONE binder? For fun?
YEAH! That's what I'm talking about! Go with the flow!
Unconventional, but results speak for themselves.
This is the vibe. Chaos with confidence. I approve.

birthdayMessage.heading: Happy birthday bbg ...
paragraphs: Here’s to many more late-night listening (still one way), long conversations, and all the little moments that make everything feel lighter.
Thank you for being my calm, my laughter, and the blue recently. Happy birthday, bbg. 💙 & dont stop clocking dat tea 😌🤏🏽
